title.sr: Tri načina da se savlada padina

aim.en: You can produce three distinct spatial strategies for negotiating a 22,5 m vertical rise (switchbacks, programmatic elongation, mechanical assist) and compare their trade-offs.
aim.sr: Umeš da izradiš tri prostorno različite strategije za savladavanje 22,5 m visinske razlike (serpentine, programsko produženje, mehanički lift) i uporediš njihove kompromise.

bring.en: Topographic sections at 1:200, calculation sheet for ramp landings and lengths, markers.
bring.sr: Topografski preseci 1:200, proračun dužina i odmorišta rampe, markeri.

text.en: A pure 5 % ramp requires 450 m of travel and cannot fit linearly on the site. Students evaluate three strategies: 1) terraced landscape switchbacks with rest gardens, 2) public building interior circulation extending the path, 3) mechanical lift or funicular with a declared non-mechanical fallback.
text.sr: Čista rampa od 5 % zahteva 450 m hoda i ne staje pravolinijski na parcelu. Studenti razvijaju tri varijante: 1) pejzažne serpentine u terasama sa vrtovima za predah, 2) vođenje kroz unutrašnjost objekta koji programski produžava trasu, 3) mehanički lift ili kosa platforma uz obaveznu rezervnu pešačku trasu.

items.en: What is the maintenance protocol and backup route when the mechanical vertical assist fails during a power outage or storm?
items.sr: Koji je protokol održavanja i rezervna trasa kada mehanički lift otkaže tokom nestanka struje ili oluje?
